Get_overdue_students.description: Asks the Fee API (through API Management) who is overdue today. The Function decides; this workflow only sends the emails. Retries every 30 s, 4 times, which covers a paused database waking up (503 with Retry-After).

Too_many_overdue.description: Safety check: more than 25 overdue students means the data is wrong, so nothing is sent (protects the sending mailbox and its 30 messages per minute limit).

runError.message: @{concat('Refusing to send ', string(body('Get_overdue_students')?['count']), ' reminders (the limit is 25). Check the data.')}

Send_reminder.description: Office 365 Outlook. Retries twice, a minute apart: fewer retries mean fewer duplicate emails if Outlook times out after sending.

body.Subject: Fee reminder: Rs. @{items('For_each_overdue_student')?['balance']} overdue since @{items('For_each_overdue_student')?['dueDate']}
body.Body:
Dear @{items('For_each_overdue_student')?['name']},

Our records show an unpaid fee balance of Rs. @{items('For_each_overdue_student')?['balance']}, which was due on @{items('For_each_overdue_student')?['dueDate']} (@{items('For_each_overdue_student')?['daysOverdue']} days ago). Student ID: @{items('For_each_overdue_student')?['studentId']}.

Please pay the outstanding amount at the earliest. If you have already paid, please ignore this message.

Regards,
Accounts Office
